name: Inflict Wounds
entries: A creature you touch makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|1-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 1.
